measurement_note: Size is n. Every tier has m = 2(n - 1), so n + m = Theta(n). The reverse-ordered chain has moderate bottleneck edges and each node also has a weight-1,000,000 direct edge to node 0. Minimax Dijkstra scales near linearly apart from heap logarithms, while a correct repeated full-edge relaxation can require Theta(n) passes and must fail only scaling.
